mission: Close E10-F5: symmetric bimanual wheelchair rim propulsion was committed as FOREHAND at 0.8 because non-stroke gates only tested the single dominant wrist. Add a symmetric two-arm-motion discriminator that abstains with an explicit limiting factor, without falsely rejecting genuine two-handed strokes.

fixtures: two-handed-backhand (NEW synthetic control fixture added this workstream: both wrists ~0.05u apart on one grip, sweeping to a contact left of midline — a genuine stroke)
datasetScope.note: Synthetic fixtures only; no human release evidence claimed. Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched; fresh-candidate pool untouched.
datasetScope.grouping: Per-fixture synthetic evaluation; no random-frame splits.

configuration.gate: symmetric bimanual motion (rim-propulsion signature) abstain gate, inserted after dominant-wrist info and before existing single-wrist non-stroke gates, in BOTH copies (swing-lab strokeHeuristic.ts v5 and vision-geometry strokeHeuristicLite.ts v3.1)
configuration.semantics: Only frame steps where BOTH wrists are visible (>=0.25) in consecutive frames count. Gate fires only when: >=5 paired steps, dominant travel >= existing NON_SWING_TRAVEL_FLOOR, rival wrist travel >= 0.7x dominant, >=70% of moving steps vertically synchronized (same sign, magnitudes within 2x), AND mean inter-wrist separation >= 0.9 shoulder-widths (separate wheel rims, not a shared paddle grip). On fire: return UNKNOWN with limiting factor symmetric_bimanual_motion_rim_propulsion_signature plus a measured evidence line.

after.measuredAt: working tree on top of base commit 8588ddd, via classifyStroke on both copies (contactMs=null, eventPeakMs=fixture peak, handedness=right)

metrics.pinFlip: E10-F5 characterization pin in packages/swing-lab/test/strokeHeuristicAmbiguous.redteam.test.ts inverted from expected FOREHAND/0.8 to expected UNKNOWN + explicit limiting factor; equivalent coverage added to packages/vision-geometry/test/strokeHeuristicLite.redteam.test.ts. Umbrella open-findings test reduced from four to three open pins (F5 resolved).

gates.pnpm format:check: pass (after prettier --write on the two touched src files)

limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; no real wheelchair-player footage was available to validate the gate on human data.
Wide-separation floor (0.9 shoulder-widths) is uncalibrated; a two-handed stroke with unusually wide grip separation is not represented in fixtures.
No Mac/iPhone/Apple Vision or coach validation performed (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL for those channels).
